quarterly_data.signal: Camtek pre-announced (October 14, 2026, ahead of its investor and analyst breakfast) that revenue for the third quarter of 2026 is expected to be $160-161 million, slightly above the previously issued guidance range and a year-over-year increase of 27% (preliminary, subject to quarter-end closing). It gave initial fourth-quarter 2026 guidance of approximately $180 million, up 40% year-over-year, which brings full-year 2026 revenues to approximately $595 million, and an initial 2027 revenue outlook of over $800 million, representing estimated growth of more than 35% over 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 2026 revenue $160-161 million (+27% YoY); Q4 2026 guidance approximately $180 million (+40% YoY); FY2026 approximately $595 million; 2027 outlook over $800 million (more than 35% growth)

quarterly_data.signal: Since the beginning of 2026 Camtek has received orders of over $800 million, with deliveries scheduled throughout 2026 and into 2027. CEO Rafi Amit: the exceptional order intake, 'driven by the very strong demand for advanced packaging for AI applications, has enabled us to build a strong backlog and pipeline, giving us visibility for 2027'; growth is expected to continue to be driven by the next-generation Hawk and Eagle G5 'as we ramp quickly with customers who continue to expand capacity to meet market demand.'
quarterly_data.figure: orders of over $800 million received in 2026 to date
